note: The commands a MANAGER may answer on its own when a prompt reaches it. Anything absent here goes to the operator. This file is the machine source; docs/permission-allowlist.md is its human-readable rendering with the rationale, and `make check-manager-allowlist` asserts the two agree. Matching is a whole-token prefix, using the same tokenizer as server/policy.mjs — so `ls` matches `ls -la /tmp` and not `lsblk`. An entry with "exact": true matches only when the command has NO further tokens, which is what stops an argument from selecting different code.
